# Instructions for sample data sets

VISAGE provides example datasets that were initially uploaded to this directory. **However, because some of these datasets are large, they have been moved to a different [repository](https://github.com/Boris-alladassi/VISAGE-example-data).**

To access and download the sample datasets, please click on the link below:

[https://github.com/Boris-alladassi/VISAGE-example-data](https://github.com/Boris-alladassi/VISAGE-example-data)

> **Note**: The datasets were relocated to prevent a slow installation of VISAGE R package.
